note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), with a second Ormeau seat vacant through the resignation of George Stewart; nominations 5 January, poll Monday 16 January 1928. Six wards were contested; the rest returned their members unopposed once Albert Edgar withdrew in Ormeau (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 7 and 17 January 1928). New member, in place of Robert Dickson. Returned unopposed.
